capabilities: collaborative-documents | Edit and organize knowledge-base pages in spaces, with application-managed accounts, collaboration, search and attachments.
description:
Docmost provides collaborative documents, spaces, search and attachments through a browser. This recipe uses its official image with PostgreSQL and a Valkey task/cache service. The community core is AGPL-3.0; the official distribution also includes license-gated Enterprise components. No Enterprise subscription, SSO or other paid feature is supplied or enabled by this recipe. Documents are stored in PostgreSQL and attachments in the docmost folder of your home.

Enroll in base, preserve the generated database password and application secret, and approve home access. Set Public address to the assigned HTTPS URL, then immediately open it and create the first workspace and owner account. The first visitor can complete setup, so do this promptly; later users join through the workspace owner. No SMTP service is configured. See How to use this service for setup and restore limits.

Customers pay the channel's platform compute base cost while the instance runs, including idle time. Labs adds no markup and receives no seller payout. This community recipe is unofficial; inclusion does not imply author endorsement or promised support.
